description:
The Huffy Disney Frozen Inline Scooter brings the magic of Arendelle to every ride with vibrant Elsa and Anna graphics. Designed for kids ages 5 and up, this kids scooter inspires imaginative outdoor adventures with every glide.
A lightweight steel frame with an aluminum deck delivers lasting durability while stable wheels provide a smooth, controlled ride. The reliable rear foot brake gives riders confidence to slow down and stop with ease.
The quick-fold design makes this Disney Frozen scooter easy to carry, store, and take on the go. Whether cruising the neighborhood or heading to the park, it's built for fun wherever the adventure leads.

components.description: Reliable Rear Foot Brake: Easy-to-use braking system gives riders confident stopping power and added safety.
